title: Pot Carrying Strap 90 kg – Lift Heavy Pots With Two People
seo_title: Pot Carrying Strap 90 kg – Lift Heavy Pots Together
seo_description: Carrying strap for heavy pots, such as olive trees and citrus. Goes around the pot with a hook, handle loops for two people, up to 90 kg.
descriptionHtml:
Your back takes the hit every time the pot has to be moved

The olive tree has to go into the garage in October and out again in May, and every move ends the same way – a sore back and a pot with a new crack. Wrestling a heavy pot along by yourself, or pulling on the rim of the pot together with someone, is hard on both back and ceramic.

A strap that lets two people carry the load together

The strap goes around the pot and is held in place with a hook, and handle loops on both sides mean two people can lift together. According to the supplier, the strap handles pots up to 90 kg.

Features

  • Two people carry instead of one back – handle loops on both sides of the strap
  • Goes around the pot instead of you wrestling it – one hook holds the strap in place
  • Carries pots up to 90 kg – according to the supplier, the strap handles that weight
  • The grip is on the strap, not on the rim of the pot – the handles take the strain when lifting

Lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

The pot and the plant are not included.
